summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTour kit by Castelli, launched 17 December 2025 with an electric-lime visibility element and new partner Datashift joining on the jersey. Chest: 'AG INSURANCE' above 'SOUDAL' (co-title sponsors), with Ekopak on the viewer-left chest and a right stack holding the Specialized 'S', the UCI Women's WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor) and 'datashift'; safety brand Safety Jogger Works sits on both shoulders and small AG and SOUDAL logos on the collar. 'SOUDAL' bands run on the upper sleeves, 'KLEIN CONSTANTIA 1685' above the sleeve cuffs, and the white AG Insurance panel wraps to the upper back. The bib shorts carry the large 'AG INSURANCE' thigh logo and 'Ekopak' above the cuffs; Castelli scorpions appear on chest, sleeves, pockets and bib legs (kit maker, listed as partner). Not marked complete: the seat of the bib shorts and the centre of the rear pocket band are not visible in the official photos checked (team launch photo and The Wolfpack Webshop replica photos).
